vector_databases.name: Qdrant
vector_databases.architecture: Rust-based vector search engine with payload-based filtering
vector_databases.payload_filtering: Rich boolean JSON filtering executed alongside vector search

pricing_tier.cloud_standard: Pay-as-you-go based on RAM/CPU (approx $25/month for 4GB RAM)

strengths: Extremely high QPS and low query latency (Rust implementation)
Advanced payload filtering without performance degradation
Native quantization reduces RAM footprint by up to 4x
trade_offs: Smaller third-party plugin ecosystem compared to older databases
Clustering in open-source requires manual topology management

vector_databases.name: Milvus
vector_databases.architecture: Distributed cloud-native vector database separating compute and storage (MinIO/Pulsar)
vector_databases.payload_filtering: Scalar attribute filtering via boolean expressions

pricing_tier.cloud_serverless: Pay-per-million CU (starts around $0.05 per million reads)

strengths: Proven horizontal scalability to billions of vector embeddings
DiskANN support enables large-scale datasets beyond RAM limits
Milvus Lite allows simple in-process Python development
trade_offs: Distributed deployment introduces high operational complexity (requires Kafka/Pulsar, MinIO, etcd)
Higher resource baseline requirements for full cluster mode

vector_databases.name: Pinecone
vector_databases.architecture: Fully managed serverless cloud vector database architecture
vector_databases.payload_filtering: Metadata filtering with standard comparison operators

pricing_tier.starter: Free tier (up to 100k vectors, single index)

strengths: Zero infrastructure maintenance; fully managed serverless experience
Instant index provisioning and seamless scaling
Reliable enterprise SLAs and high availability
trade_offs: Strictly vendor-locked cloud SaaS; cannot be self-hosted on-premises or air-gapped
Predicting monthly costs under bursty read workloads can be complex

vector_databases.name: Weaviate
vector_databases.architecture: Go-based vector search engine with integrated multi-modal modules and GraphQL/REST
vector_databases.payload_filtering: GraphQL/REST filtering on cross-referenced objects and inverted indexes
strengths: Modular architecture with out-of-the-box vectorizer modules (OpenAI, HuggingFace)
Hybrid search (BM25 + Vector) built directly into core
Object cross-referencing capabilities resembling a knowledge graph
trade_offs: Go garbage collection tuning necessary under very high memory allocations
Complex schema definitions compared to pure key-value vector stores

vector_databases.name: Chroma
vector_databases.architecture: Python/Rust-based embedded or client-server vector store built for AI application rapid prototyping
strengths: Zero-friction installation (`pip install chromadb`) and local prototyping
Default built-in embedding functions for quick RAG starts
Lightweight footprint ideal for desktop apps and unit tests
trade_offs: Historically focused on embedded rather than massive distributed multi-tenant workloads
Fewer advanced quantization options for billion-scale production deployments
